title: Podcast planning
text:
Iris: Let's plan the next three episodes of the podcast.
Theo: The first one should be about how small teams plan their week. Listeners keep asking for it.
Iris: Good. Who could we invite as a guest?
Theo: Someone who runs a team of five or six. I know a couple of founders who would talk about it.
Iris: Second episode?
Theo: A listener questions episode. We have twenty questions in the inbox.
Iris: That one is easy to record. We could do it next week.
Theo: The third could be about writing good meeting notes.
Iris: Nice. We should keep each episode under forty minutes. The last two ran long.
Theo: Agreed. I will cut the intro music shorter too.
Iris: For the recording schedule, Tuesday mornings work best for me.
Theo: Tuesdays are fine. I will book the studio for the next three weeks.
Iris: And I will write to the guests today.
